lines.hanzi: 上个星期天我去了北京。
lines.pinyin: Shàng ge xīngqītiān wǒ qù le Běijīng.
lines.english: Last Sunday I went to Beijing.

lines.hanzi: 星期六上午我坐火车去的。
lines.pinyin: Xīngqīliù shàngwǔ wǒ zuò huǒchē qù de.
lines.english: Saturday morning I went by train.

lines.hanzi: 到了北京，我先去了王明家。
lines.pinyin: Dào le Běijīng, wǒ xiān qù le Wáng Míng jiā.
lines.english: Arrived in Beijing, I first went to Wang Ming's home.

lines.hanzi: 我们一起吃了饭，喝了茶。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen yīqǐ chī le fàn, hē le chá.

lines.hanzi: 星期天我们去学校跑步。
lines.english: Sunday we went to the school to run.

lines.hanzi: 下午四点我坐火车回家。
lines.pinyin: Xiàwǔ sì diǎn wǒ zuò huǒchē huí jiā.
lines.english: At four PM I took the train home.
